task.evidence_cut_semantics: Capture-time hosted readback only. The public dev BFF endpoint is shared and redeployed continuously by many concurrent, unrelated tasks in this fleet; the exact source_commit_sha observed drifts between checks (183cba0... and 7c2e3673b... were both observed minutes apart during this evidence cut, neither an ancestor of the other). This manifest does not assert a stable current runtime after evidence_cut_at. It does assert that every observed hosted config_posture during this cut was auth_stub:true / auth_mode:permissive, which is the systemic symptom this task's fix targets, not a one-off stale artifact.

RISK-LOOP-PROD-AUTH-001-REDEPLOY-PENDING.containment: The corrected default only ships to the hosted dev BFF on the next 'Pantheon Nonprod Deploy' run (human-triggered workflow_dispatch or the next automatic publish cut); until then the hosted BFF continues to run permissive/stub auth, which is the pre-existing (not newly introduced) posture.
RISK-LOOP-PROD-AUTH-001-REDEPLOY-PENDING.description: scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh's corrected DEV_BFF_AUTH_STUB/DEV_BFF_AUTH_MODE defaults have not yet been observed live on the hosted dev BFF as of evidence_cut_at.
RISK-LOOP-PROD-AUTH-001-REDEPLOY-PENDING.recheck_trigger: After the next Pantheon Nonprod Deploy run that includes this PR's merge SHA, re-curl GET /bff/version (expect auth_stub:false, auth_mode:strict) and GET /bff/me with an arbitrary fixed bearer (expect 401).

RISK-LOOP-PROD-AUTH-001-DEV-LOGIN-CREDEN.containment: dev-login fails closed (403 PRECONDITION_FAILED) when credentials are absent, so this gap does not create an authentication bypass; it only blocks proving the distinct-identity acceptance criteria end-to-end against the hosted BFF.
RISK-LOOP-PROD-AUTH-001-DEV-LOGIN-CREDEN.description: Neither docker-compose.yml nor scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh provisions PANTHEON_BFF_DEV_LOGIN_CLIENT_ID/_SECRET (or the PANTHEON_BFF_OIDC_CLIENT_ID/_SECRET fallback) or PANTHEON_BFF_JWT_SECRET; these must come from a secret store outside this repo and were not fabricated here.
RISK-LOOP-PROD-AUTH-001-DEV-LOGIN-CREDEN.recheck_trigger: Once credentials are provisioned on the hosted dev host, run a scripted six-persona (viewer/operator/approver/risk-owner/operator-A/operator-B) dev-login and negative-security-proof matrix against the hosted BFF and capture the readback.

RISK-LOOP-PROD-AUTH-001-IMAGE-DIGEST.containment: git SHA, environment, and (after redeploy) build_time still identify the deployed build precisely; image_digest is a secondary identity field.
RISK-LOOP-PROD-AUTH-001-IMAGE-DIGEST.description: image_digest has no source anywhere in this repo's build pipeline: images are built locally on the VM via 'docker compose up -d --build' and never pushed to a registry, so there is no OCI registry digest. Populating this field requires a follow-up change that captures the local image ID via 'docker inspect' after build and re-injects it as BFF_IMAGE_DIGEST, which was out of scope for this fix.
RISK-LOOP-PROD-AUTH-001-IMAGE-DIGEST.recheck_trigger: Implement the build+inspect+redeploy sequence and observe /bff/version report a non-'unknown' image_digest live.
